$comment: Ratchet baseline for `astro check --minimumSeverity error`. This number may only go DOWN. tests/typecheck-baseline.typecheck.ts fails if it rises (a regression) and also fails if it drops (so the baseline is retightened rather than quietly leaving slack). Run `pnpm test:types` to check, then lower `total` to the reported count.

notes.concentration: src/pages/theleague/rosters.astro still dominates this number. The split plan in docs/plans/rosters-page-split.md is the route down: each extracted module takes its errors with it, because an exported function needs a signature. Verify the inline script via @astrojs/compiler transform + esbuild parse, NOT a full astro check (see docs/claude/insights/features/august-roster-cuts.md).
notes.composition: The bulk is implicit-any annotation debt (ts7006/7005/7053) plus property-access noise (ts2339), not defects. The null-safety class outside rosters.astro is at zero and should stay there.
notes.provenance: 1769 after pruning the dead dynamic-matchup-previews cluster: 7 unrendered components, 11 unreachable utils and their 14 spec tests, ~7,000 lines that no entry point reached. The -36 is pure deletion — no file that survives changed, so nothing was suppressed or re-typed to get here. Previously 1805 after the AFL Throwback Week build was rebased onto main. Neither pre-rebase number survived the rebase, so this is a fresh measurement, not a merge of the two. The branch's own -2 came from unforking src/pages/theleague/throwback-settings.astro: its 581 lines became a 54-line route wrapper plus a shared component and a typed view resolver (src/utils/throwback-settings-view.ts), and the commissioner-panel row shapes that were inline interfaces in the page now have real exported types. Main stood at 1808, itself down from 1809 after the first extraction phases of the rosters-page split (docs/plans/rosters-page-split.md) — the page's inline copies of the cap math, row shaping and age analytics were replaced by the CANONICAL shared modules that already held them (src/utils/salary-calculations.ts, roster-utils.ts, age-utils.ts) rather than by new parallel ones, it adopted constants/roster-constants instead of local redefinitions, and dead code (createPlayerLookup + three duplicated payload keys) was removed; measured on main at a2d3f4d, which stood at 1912, so that split removed 103. The Draft Results page was typed CanonicalLeagueSlug, which includes best-ball-1 and is not assignable to DraftNav's two-league prop; narrowing it to DraftLeagueSlug (the page only exists for TheLeague and the AFL) removed the error rather than suppressing it.
notes.clearedClasses: These classes were driven to zero and are pinned there separately, because the total alone cannot protect them: an improvement elsewhere can mask a regression in one of these and still leave the total lower, which the ratchet would read as progress.
